newsitem.title: UK: Medway Insurance seeks London stock market listing.
newsitem.headline: Medway Insurance seeks London stock market listing.

text.p: Medway Insurance Group Plc said on Wednesday it was to seek admission to London's Alternative Investment Market ("AIM") by way of a placing.
Medway was founded in December 1996 as a Lloyd's orientated US licensed insurance company.
Specific emphasis will be placed on US non-marine short and medium tail business and the company said it intended to avoid business with catastrophe and/or cumulative exposures.

The purpose of the placing is to raise approximately 70 million stg ($114.4 million) to finance the $54 million proposed acquisition of a US licensed insurance company, Hansa Re, from Focus Insurance Holdings Inc. and provide working capital for Medway.
Focus is to purchase Hansa Re from Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa AB, subject to certain terms, including financing.
On completion of the acquisition, Hansa Re, to be re-named Medway Insurance Company, will be recapitalised with net assets of $100 million.
"We will make Medway available to Lloyd's underwriters, Lloyd's brokers and US brokers as a conduit for business to Lloyd's." said Medway chief executive Emmanuel Olympitis.

"Medway intends to underwrite suitable US business and reinsure a substantial part with Lloyd's, retaining a portion for its own account. It is expected that over time an increasing amount of this business will be new to Lloyd's."
Hansa Re has multi-line insurance licenses in 16 states, including New York, California, Illinois and Texas. It has reinsurance-only licenses or is an accredited reinsurer in a further 19 states.
It hopes to increase the number of multi-line licenses to cover all 50 states as soon as possible.
The board of Medway is chaired by Sir Raymond Johnstone, a founder of Murray Johnstone and a director and past chairman of Scottish Amicable Life.
